meta.description: Daily snapshot of the curated Polymarket events' Yes prices (0-1), one row per UTC date, written by scripts/polymarket/append_history.py after each fetch. Events carried forward as stale are not recorded.
meta.backfill: Rows from 2026-04-06 to 2026-10-10 were rebuilt from the git history of data/polymarket-data.json (the last committed snapshot of each UTC date). Before the fetcher recorded settlement, a resolved market stayed in that file at its final price, so the backfill keeps only the events still live on 2026-10-10; resolved ones are left out. Dates with no commit that day have no row.
